resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Icelandic source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Icelandic pass identified 25 actionable formula, terminology, grammar, and technical-clarity defects across electrical, trigonometric, thermal, heat-flux, unit-conversion, and wire-gauge content; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Icelandic human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The rearranged Ohm's-law formula used compressed division notation.
evidence: The previous expression was I = V/R.
findings.resolution: Restored the readable protected notation I = V / R.

findings.summary: The resistance rearrangement used compressed division notation.
evidence: The previous expression was R = V/I.
findings.resolution: Restored the readable protected notation R = V / I.

findings.summary: The resistance definition used an inconsistent technical form.
evidence: The previous bullet did not use the standard Icelandic term consistently.
findings.resolution: Changed it to R er viðnám, mælt í ohmum (Ω).

findings.summary: The worked-example heading was a literal translation with awkward agreement.
evidence: The previous heading was Unnið dæmi.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the natural technical heading Reiknidæmi.

findings.summary: The TCR name was less natural and did not clearly identify resistance.
evidence: The previous display name used a literal coefficient phrase.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Hitastuðull viðnáms (TCR).

findings.summary: The TCR example heading was a literal translation.
evidence: The previous heading was Unnið dæmi.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Reiknidæmi.

findings.summary: The trigonometry example title was awkwardly literal.
evidence: The previous title did not read naturally as an instruction.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Finndu eina hlið.

findings.summary: The trigonometry setup used an unnatural construction for the hypotenuse and angle.
evidence: The previous setup was a literal rendering of the English sentence.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a 10 cm hypotenuse forming a 30° angle.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity example heading was a literal translation.
evidence: The previous heading was Unnið dæmi.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Reiknidæmi.

findings.summary: The electrical-heating setup was unclear about the ideal no-loss assumption.
evidence: The previous setup did not state the constant 100 W source and no-loss condition clearly.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it to specify 41,8 kJ, a constant 100 W source, and no losses.

findings.summary: The object/material heading was less natural in Icelandic.
evidence: The previous title used a literal noun sequence.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Hlutur og efni.

findings.summary: The phase-change heading omitted the practical-limit context.
evidence: The previous title was shorter and less precise.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Fasabreytingar og hagnýtar takmarkanir.

findings.summary: The heat-flux display name used a general heat-flow term instead of the per-area quantity.
evidence: The previous name did not distinguish heat-flux density.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Varmaflæðisþéttleiki.

findings.summary: The heat-flux example heading was a literal translation.
evidence: The previous heading was Unnið dæmi.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Reiknidæmi.

findings.summary: The heat-flux setup did not clearly express the area over which the heater transfers heat.
evidence: The previous setup was less direct about the 0,020 m² area.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it to state that a 100 W heater transfers heat through 0,020 m².

findings.summary: The practical-checks heading was not idiomatic.
evidence: The previous heading used a less natural literal form.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Hagnýtar athuganir.

findings.summary: The SI base-units heading was not idiomatic.
evidence: The previous title used a literal plural construction.
findings.resolution: Changed it to SI-grunneiningar.

findings.summary: The foot-to-metre conversion formula used a less consistent notation.
evidence: The previous formula did not use the corrected Icelandic unit wording and spacing.
findings.resolution: Restored 1 fet = 12 tommur = 0,3048 m.

findings.summary: The yard-to-metre conversion formula used a less consistent notation.
evidence: The previous formula did not use the corrected Icelandic unit wording and spacing.
findings.resolution: Restored 1 yard = 3 fet = 0,9144 m.

findings.summary: The heading for additional unit conversions was awkwardly literal.
evidence: The previous title did not read naturally as a section heading.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Fleiri algengir umreikningar.

findings.summary: The wire-gauge display name used a less natural term for sizes.
evidence: The previous name used Vírmælar for the concept title.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Vírstærðir: AWG, SWG og BWG.

findings.summary: The gauge-number guidance had incorrect grammar and inconsistent capitalization.
evidence: The previous bullet used Stærri venjulegt mælitala and an unnecessary capital after the semicolon.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with correct agreement and consistent lowercase wording.

findings.summary: The AWG formula heading used an awkward compound.
evidence: The previous title lacked a natural Icelandic compound for diameter and area.
findings.resolution: Changed it to AWG-þvermál og flatarmál.

findings.summary: The wire-resistance heading used a less precise term for wire size.
evidence: The previous title began with Mál and was ambiguous in context.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Vírstærð, flatarmál og viðnám.

findings.summary: The practical-specification heading was a literal translation.
evidence: The previous title used a less natural phrase for a practical specification.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Hagnýt lýsing.
